diagnosis: 54 5-star reviews on Google Maps but zero web presence—losing qualified leads who research before calling. No website means no SEO, no portfolio showcase, no credibility checkpoint for new customers.
hero_angle: Perfect 5.0 rating with substantial review volume proves reliability; a website captures that trust and converts browsers into callers.
cold_message: Hey — 54 five-star reviews on Google is legit. But when someone in Denver, CO searches "electrician near me" tonight, they're booking whoever has a website. You're losing jobs to guys with half your reputation. Worth a quick fix? — Dave, Trevo Advisors
